Page10 of158 T-RICH Pre-FEED Report – Public Version 2.1.1 ABOUT APTAMUS CARBON SOLUTIONS As of this writing, Aptamus Carbon Solutions is a subsidiary of Overseas Shipholding Group, Inc. (OSG), this grant’s prime recipient, and a member of the Saltchuk family of companies. Aptamus was formed to leverage OSG’s 80 years of shipping experience with liquid bulk commodities in tanker vessels into the marine transportation of carbon dioxide, a product never before carried on the waters of the United States. Aptamus’ principals have more than a combined 100 years managing engineering and construction projects, much of it in the marine field. Aptamus intends to focus on development of CO -carrying ships 2 and the marine terminals at which they will load and discharge their CO . The T-RICH intermodal CO hub 2 2 and ship loading terminal is a critical piece of that planned value chain. Aptamus’ principals, including this grant’s principal investigator, are also heavily involved in providing technical support to OSG’s fleet of 21 crude, product and chemical tankers. Project work includes building new vessels or heavily modifying existing ones, incorporating environmental technology like ballast water treatment systems and emissions reduction technology, and studying future methods of reducing emissions even further such as retrofitting onboard carbon capture and storage systems which could offload their captured CO at the T-RICH hub. 2 Aptamus and OSG are both owned by Saltchuk, a privately owned family of diversified freight transportation (including marine shipping companies and airlines), marine service, and energy distribution companies headquartered in Seattle, WA. With consolidated annual revenue of approximately $5.5 billion and 8,500 employees, Saltchuk has the resources necessary to commit to large CO -related infrastructure 2 projects once they are ready to be built. 2.1.2 ABOUT ENTR, PART OF AKER SOLUTIONS Entr draws upon Aker Solutions’ rich heritage of innovation and project development to deliver insights, advice, and solutions to customers, enabling robust decision making and maximum value from inception to implementation. As Aker Solutions dedicated consultancy arm, Entr builds upon a deep technical expertise and broad understanding of the commercial, economic, ESG, regulatory and supply chain challenges, to support customers in navigating the new energy landscape. Aker’s CCS journey began in the 1990s, and since then, it has continued to deliver first-of-a-kind CCS projects to clients across the globe. It has successfully delivered the Sleipner CO -storage platform and 2 the engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) of the amine plant at the CO Technology Centre in 2 Mongstad, Norway – the world’s largest and most advanced facility for testing carbon capture technologies. Aker Solutions leverages its strong project expertise, engineering competence, and proven delivery models to deliver viable and scalable solutions for large and complex developments, facilities, and sites across the entire CCS value chain. From capture to injection, it provides innovative solutions working with leading technology partners to help pave the way for commercial CCS.
